lines: Emotions glitter, now they glitter.
You are everything.
This sweet world feels like a lie.
Let's erase everything else.
My sense of liking goes out of focus.
It's discommunication with the outside world.
The hidden love deep in my chest I will not let anyone see.
Whether I love or not, nothing becomes stained.
No longer will angels or demons whisper here.
With the dull heartbeat hidden in my uniform pocket, let's try running away together.
Eternity holds no meaning, yet.
Stay there forever.
Emotions glitter, sparkling because of you.
Only the present I am is myself.
If this sweet world becomes a lie,
I don't need anything else.
Seiwō
Laughing emotion, gray feelings, I don't need them now.
Let's keep singing love.
If we're in this room, it will surely be bright.
An identity that remains lost.
I never even intended to search.
Just constantly craving “I love you.”
Alone, I can do nothing.
That child, that child, me, that guy— all zero points.
I was drunk on the self that knows this is why it can't be.
But in a crowd like weeds, you remain yourself, you are perfect.
You turned all the hidden, sealed ambiguity into me.
Angel‑like dummy attitudes and the frantic discomu mode.
It's everything I show you.
Laugh at my flaws too.
Whether it's not the real me or whatever, I don't care anymore.
Every day is sloppy, my eye is sloppy, even the always sloppy is me.
If this bland life didn't exist, neither I nor you would be.
Emotions glitter, sparkling because of you.
Only the now I'm doing isn't everything.
Both the lies and truths of this sweet world.
After all, give them to me, they're all me.
Seiwō
Shouting emotion, the patched veil I no longer need.
Let's keep singing love.
From inside this room, let's change everything.
